text:
The response is accurate. Every figure matches the original: 81% vs 74%, 60% free-month customers, the 78% vs 76% paid-only comparison, $95 per session, $410,000 a year, the 60-day randomised test, and the 21 October decision point. It also correctly notes that Sales' "proved" claim isn't supported. It covers all the points a manager needs.

The main problem is the explicit length limit. The response runs to roughly 200 words, well over the 120-word cap. Its heading, bullet labels and filler phrases ("I would kindly recommend", "at this stage") add length without adding content. A tighter version could have kept every key point under 120 words.

Accuracy is near-perfect and coverage is complete, but the response clearly breaks the length constraint, which is a significant instruction-following failure.

Score: 5
